description: Fixed contrast set for harness A/B runs on the gemma-4 developer agent. It is not a resolution-rate estimate: tasks are chosen for signal and repository coverage, not sampled at random.
selection: Selected from the 69 tasks with at least one archived run under runs/ (read 2026-10-26). Keeps six of the eleven tasks that resolved at least once (rich_3006, rich_3061, rich_3063, requests_7315, requests_7427, fastapi_15589) and five that never resolved, covering test_failure (rich_3468, rich_3777, requests_6644, fastapi_15588) and collection_error (httpx_3672). Excludes every task whose archived run had infra_error=true. Per-repository caps: rich 5, requests 3, fastapi 2, httpx 1. Deliberately not corpus-proportional: fastapi has 67 tasks but only three non-infra archived results.
